home.title: Import listings
home.subtitle: Bring companies from an Excel/CSV file or an external API into the system, with automatic duplicate checks.
home.notFound: No import yet. Start with "New import" — a dry run first is recommended.

action.publishConfirm: Publish {{ count }} draft listings to the website now?
action.importAgain: Import for real with this file

new.title: New import
new.fileHint: .xlsx or .csv (UTF-8) file, up to 100 MB. The first row holds column names (Vietnamese or English). See the template for all 28 columns.
new.badType: Only .xlsx or .csv files (old .xls: open in Excel and save as .xlsx).
new.dryRun: Dry run — classify only, write nothing to listings
new.dryRunHelp: Run a dry run first: check created / merged / suspected counts and row notes, then import for real.
new.realRunWarning: Real import: new listings are created as drafts (not on the website yet), duplicates get their empty fields filled.

api.sourceHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes. Stored on listings as api:<code>. Re-importing the same source matches the same records.
api.itemsPath: Path to the array of companies
api.itemsPathHelp: Dotted, e.g. data.items. Empty if the root JSON is an array.
api.headersHelp: One per line: Name: value (e.g. X-API-Key: …).
api.fieldMappingHelp: When JSON keys differ from standard names. One per line: standard name = path in item (e.g. taxCode = mst).
api.invalidSource: Source code may only contain lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
api.invalidUrl: URL must start with http:// or https://

list.running: Running import #{{ id }} · {{ count }} rows processed · {{ duration }}

statusHelp.SUSPECT: Name close to an existing listing (with phone / address) — needs review
statusHelp.CREATED: No duplicate → new listing, as draft
statusHelp.MERGED: Certain duplicate (tax code / source id) → empty fields filled
statusHelp.DUPLICATE_IN_BATCH: Same as an earlier row in the same file

detail.title: Import #{{ id }}
detail.dryRunNotice: This was a dry run: results show what WOULD happen; nothing was written. Import the file again without "Dry run" to write.
detail.runningNotice: Processing… this page updates itself. You can leave; the import keeps running.
detail.suspectNotice: {{ count }} suspected duplicates waiting for review.

review.title: Compare
review.mergeHelp: Fill empty fields of the existing listing, never overwrite
review.dryRunBlocked: Dry-run rows cannot be reviewed — import for real first.
